summary: In HCJ 2412/23, the High Court issued a conditional order requiring Netanyahu and the Knesset to explain why the incapacity-law amendment should not take effect only from a later Knesset, and expanded the panel to 11 justices.
notes: Historical August backfill lead only. The Aug. 6 order was procedural/interim and is not itself a final accountability finding. Later, on Jan. 3 2024, a 6-5 majority delayed the amendment's effect until the next Knesset, with majority reasoning reported as identifying a clear/personal purpose; that later final disposition should be handled in the appropriate 2024 period or merged after primary judgment recovery. Do not infer motive beyond judicial findings. Primary Aug. 6 order text was not recovered this pass, so no canonical event is created yet.
